products.name: Fixed Income Fund
products.description: A professionally managed fund focused on generating stable income through fixed-income securities.
products.objectives: To provide investors with relatively stable income and capital preservation.

products.name: Equity Growth Fund
products.description: A fund that invests primarily in company shares with the objective of long-term capital growth.
products.objectives: To achieve long-term capital appreciation through equity investments.

products.name: Money Market Fund
products.description: A short-term investment fund focused on money market instruments and liquidity.
products.objectives: To provide liquidity and income through short-term money market instruments.

products.name: Balanced Investment Fund
products.description: A diversified fund combining equity and fixed-income investments.
products.objectives: To balance capital growth and income through diversified investments.

products.name: Real Estate Investment Fund
products.description: A fund providing exposure to income-generating real estate assets.
products.objectives: To provide long-term growth and potential income through real estate exposure.
